rules.source: Personal Data Protection Act (ZVOP-2), Official Gazette of the Republic of Slovenia No. 163/22 — https://ey.com/en_si/ey-slovenia-law-news/law-news-january-2023
rules.retrieved_snippet: EY Slovenia: the National Assembly adopted ZVOP-2 on 15 December 2022, it was published in the Official Gazette on 27 December 2022 and entered into force on 26 January 2023, repealing ZVOP-1; the Information Commissioner continues as supervisory authority and can impose the fines prescribed in GDPR Article 83.

rules.source: Consumer Protection Act (ZVPot-1), published in the Official Gazette 11 October 2022 — https://selih.si/en/general/new-provisions-to-be-introduced-by-the-new-consumer-protection-act-in-slovenia/
rules.retrieved_snippet: Selih & Partnerji / EY: ZVPot-1 was passed by the National Assembly on 29 September 2022, published 11 October 2022, with main obligations applying from 26 January 2023; it transposes Directives 2019/770, 2019/771 and 2019/2161 and absorbed the Act on Consumer Protection against Unfair Commercial Practices.

rules.source: Criminal Code (KZ-1) Article 297, public incitement to hatred, violence or intolerance — https://fra.europa.eu/en/databases/anti-muslim-hatred/case-law/9668
rules.retrieved_snippet: FRA case-law database: a 2024 Supreme Court judgment (I Ips 32326/2021) upheld a conviction for public incitement to hatred, violence or intolerance under Article 297 KZ-1; commentary describes the offence as a narrow criminal hate-speech offence tied to Article 63 of the Constitution. Current consolidated Article 297 text not retrieved.

rules.source: Criminal Code (KZ-1) Article 221, attack on an information system — Council of Europe Budapest Convention legal profile — https://rm.coe.int/octocom-legal-profile-slovenia/16809e5a30
rules.retrieved_snippet: Council of Europe profile reproduces Article 221(1): entering or breaking into an information system without authorisation, and unauthorised interception of data transfers to, from or within a non-public system, punishable by up to one year of imprisonment (an older profile; current wording and penalty not verified against the official text).

rules.source: Audiovisual Media Services Act (ZAvMS) as amended by ZAvMS-B (in force January 2022) and the AKOS General Act on the protection of children and minors — https://rm.coe.int/avmsd-transposition-info-sheet-si-/1680aa581b
rules.retrieved_snippet: Council of Europe observatory: Slovenia transposed AVMSD Article 28b into ZAvMS, requiring video-sharing platform providers under Slovenian jurisdiction to protect children from harmful content; the 2021 amendment ZAvMS-B, in force since January 2022, brought the AVMSD minors rules including age categories and access restrictions; the regulator AKOS supervises compliance (https://www.akos-rs.si/en/tv-radio-and-vod/exposing/responsibilities-for-content-control).
